notes.title: Hello, friends!
notes.content:
Teleportals is participating in a puzzle fest, yay! [b]Greetings[/b] to newcomers and those who have been with us a long time and decided to refresh their memories.


For those who’re playing the game for the first time.
Remember:
[b]-[/b]You can turn off the story in the settings.
[b]-[/b]I have a [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/TH4MCCG ]Discord[/url] server where I occasionally give out keys from my other games, and where you can ask about where to get the [b]OST[/b] and maybe some patch =)
[b]-[/b]If a certain level is pissing you off, you can skip it.


[b]-[/b]Also the new season of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1357830/Arcana_Heat_and_Cold_Season_1/]Arcana[/url] is coming out in about 3 weeks.
[b]-[/b]Spirits of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2233220/Spirits_of_The_Silicium_Forest/]The Silicium Forest[/url] production is going on as usual – currently I’m testing builds, balance, etc.

[b]Hope you’re doing well. See you soon![/b]
